strings.zh: 哺乳期可用、孕期友善的選擇：
部分產後肝斑會在 6-12 個月內自然淡化（若哺乳結束、停止口服避孕藥）。但已存在多年的肝斑、有家族史的、停經期再起的，通常不會自然消退。哺乳期可使用「物理性防曬+杜鵑花酸」溫和方案，生完哺乳結束再考慮三合一藥膏或雷射。
strings.en: Some postpartum melasma fades in 6–12 months (after lactation ends and oral contraceptives are stopped). But long-standing melasma, familial cases, and perimenopausal recurrences typically don't self-resolve. During lactation use a gentle physical-sunscreen + azelaic-acid regimen; after weaning, consider triple cream or laser.

strings.zh: 會。男性肝斑約占 10-20%，亞洲（尤其印度、東南亞）男性比例更高。臨床表現相同，治療相同。男性肝斑常被誤認為曬斑而錯誤雷射造成反黑加重。
strings.en: Yes. Men make up 10–20% of melasma cases, with higher proportions in Asia (especially India and Southeast Asia). Clinical presentation and treatment are identical. Male melasma is often misdiagnosed as sunspots and mis-lasered, causing rebound hyperpigmentation.

strings.zh: 分布：對稱、額頭、雙頰、上唇、下巴
strings.en: Distribution: symmetric — forehead, cheeks, upper lip, chin

strings.zh: 原因：UV + 可見光 + 荷爾蒙 + 慢性發炎
strings.en: Cause: UV + visible light + hormones + chronic inflammation
Population: 30+ women, more common in Asians

strings.zh: 原因：真皮層黑色素細胞
分布：陽光照射區、不對稱
原因：長期 UV 累積
分布：臉頰鼻樑、可不對稱
strings.en: Distribution: cheeks and nasal bridge, can be asymmetric

strings.zh: 戶外工作者（漁夫、工地、業務、外送）
治療策略相同（防曬 + 杜鵑花酸 + 必要時三合一）
strings.en: Same treatment strategy (sunscreen + azelaic acid + triple cream if needed)

strings.zh: 避免：口服傳明酸、外用 A 酸、氫醌、強烈雷射 — 全部等斷奶後
strings.en: Avoid: oral tranexamic acid, topical retinoids, hydroquinone, aggressive laser — all postponed until weaning

strings.zh: 紫外線 + 可見光 / 藍光

strings.en: Have a dermatologist examine in person

strings.zh: 低能量、多次數、並用藥膏
strings.en: low-fluence, multiple sessions, combined with topicals

strings.zh: 傳統 Q-switched 釹雅鉻雷射

strings.en: should not be first-line for melasma

strings.zh: 低能量釹雅鉻雷射(Laser Toning)
皮秒雷射(Picosure / Picoway / Discovery Pico)
每天防曬 + 每天藥膏 + 必要時口服
strings.en: Daily sunscreen + daily topical + oral when needed
without sun protection it tans back

strings.zh: 同時轉用 maintenance 成分
夏天到了又沒補擦防曬
strings.en: summer arrives and you don't reapply

strings.zh: 可見光(400-700 nm)會加重肝斑
陽光暴露 + 慢性發炎
哺乳期結束後仍未消退就要積極治療
strings.en: treat aggressively if it persists after lactation ends

strings.zh: 物理性 + 氧化鐵防曬
溫和入門 · 居家保養
含氧化鐵 SPF30+ 防曬
處方加碼 · 外用三合一
能量療程 · 雷射 / 脈衝光
必須同時搭外用 + 防曬
strings.en: Must be combined with topicals + sun protection

strings.zh: 含氧化鐵 SPF 30+ PA+++ 防曬
杜鵑花酸 / 傳明酸外用
肝斑是慢性疾病，治療要靠「防曬 + 藥膏 + 必要時口服 + 雷射輔助」四管齊下，單靠任何一項都不夠
strings.en: Melasma is a chronic disease — successful treatment combines sunscreen + topical + oral when needed + adjunctive laser; no single intervention is sufficient

strings.zh: 傳明酸 Lumius、純氫醌 4%、Skinoren 雅若
strings.en: Tranexamic acid (Lumius), pure hydroquinone 4%, Skinoren (azelaic acid)

strings.zh: 雷射打不掉？藥膏越濃越好？停藥就反黑？
strings.en: Laser doesn't clear it? Stronger cream is better? Stopping causes rebound?

strings.zh: 溫和果酸/杏仁酸 5-10%(夜間）加速代謝。痘痘肌可改成水楊酸 1-2%。
strings.en: Gentle AHA / mandelic acid 5–10% (nighttime) accelerates turnover. Switch to salicylic acid 1–2% if acne-prone.

strings.zh: 挑有 SPF + 帶有色素粉體者
strings.en: Choose those with SPF + tinted pigment particles
